title: AM-GM Generalization to Operator Means in Matrix Analysis

problemStatement.formal: axiom operator_am_gm (A B : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : RealPosDef A) (hB : RealPosDef B) : matGeomMean A B hA hB ≤_L matArithMean A B
problemStatement.plain: For positive definite matrices A and B, the matrix geometric mean A#B is dominated by the arithmetic mean (A+B)/2 in the Loewner (semidefinite) ordering. This generalizes the scalar AM-GM inequality to operator means.
whyMatters: Generalizes the classical AM-GM from scalars to matrices
Foundation of Kubo-Ando theory of operator means (1980)
Applications in quantum information theory and matrix optimization
Connects to the Loewner order, a fundamental partial order on Hermitian matrices

proven: PSD/PD basics: zero PSD, sum/scaling preserve PSD, PD implies PSD
Loewner order: reflexivity, transitivity, addition, non-negative scaling
Arithmetic mean: PSD preservation, bounds lesser operand
Equality condition: A = B implies A#B = (A+B)/2
Weighted arithmetic mean: PSD preservation, half-weight = AM
